title: It's ok, but I was underwhelmed. Spoilers for April 2021
text:
The April 2021 kit had 5 items plus a bonus item (the mask or the scrub; I forget which). There was also a sheet with discount codes. From the item description photo, I expected there would be a small zippered bag of some sort as well, but no.

* eye shadow (the color went on pretty pale, which was fine by me, cool)
* lip gloss (that I thought I would hate, but actually looked ok on, yay!)
* mascara (awful- got all over everything an difficult to remove, boo)
* moisturizer (haven't tried it yet)
* sheet face mask (haven't used yet-UPDATE: I LOVE the lotion!)
* coffee scrub (which was absolutely dry in it's foil package, which I think developed a tiny hole en route, and I'm not sure it was meant to be this dry-bummer).

But, you're basically buying a blind bag, and sometimes you don't love what's in it- that's just part of the nature of a blind bag.
label: neutral
